title: Add keepAlive justification comments to live content_browsing providers
why: SM-6 requires an inline justification beside every keepAlive: true so a reviewer can tell a deliberate cache-lifetime decision from a copy-pasted default. None of these three explain why losing the cached value on last-listener-disappear would be wrong — contrast with contentRepositoryProvider 3 lines above curriculumHeNames in the same file, which does explain it ('rebuilding this provider would discard cached data').
recommendation: Add a one-line '// keepAlive: <reason>' per the pattern already used in sync_orchestrator_providers.dart, e.g. for FontSizeNotifier/ShowNikud: 'font-size/nikud toggles must survive navigating away from the reader and back.'
acceptance_criteria: the [Pending] audit grep requiring a justification comment beside keepAlive: true (coding-standards.md SM-6) finds a comment within 2 lines of each @Riverpod(keepAlive: true) in this feature
